description:
Must Have: 

 1. API Gateway experience   
2. C# experience, running and investigating failures in C# test   

 Testing the implementation of an API Gateway and other application infrastructure.   
4-6 years experience in infrastructure testing .   

 This position is on our automation infrastructure teams and is in support of the Digital API team.   
Experience with an API Gateway product such as Mashery, Apigee or NGinX is preferred.   

 This person will be testing new implementation of API Gateways. They will be working with internal developers and whoever (internal and external) provides the API gateways in testing and debugging the applications. Test plan and test case creating experience.   

 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
